headlines.title: [ 2026 모태펀드] 출자 63% 증액, '넥스트유니콘' 전진 배치
headlines.summary: 이 기사는 2026년 01월 28일 17시 07분 넘버스 유료 사이트에 발행된 기사입니다. / 그래픽 = 박진화 기자 올해 중소벤처기업부 소관 모태펀드 1차 정시 출자사업 규모가 지난해와 비교해 60% 이상 대폭 늘었다. 지난해 하반기 추가경정예산을 투입해 2차 정시 사업에 편성했던 넥스트 유니콘 프로젝트를 올해는 1차로 전진 배치한 영향이다.

headlines.title: 구윤철 " 공공조달 , AI 혁신 의 마중물로"…AI 전용트랙 신설
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 구윤철 부총리, 뉴로메카 방문…혁신조달 기업 대표들과 간담회 혁신·우수제품 'AI 전용 트랙' 도입…'국산부품 의무화' 공급망 강화 구윤철(오른쪽) 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 27일 서울 성동구 소재 인공지능(AI) 혁신기업 (주)뉴로메카를 방문해 관계자의 설명을 듣고 있다.

headlines.title: " 원화 국제화 는 외환 · 금융시장 도약 핵심과제"…범정부 TF 출범
headlines.summary: 원화 접근성 제고, 국경간 원화거래 수요 확대 방안 논의 상반기 원화 국제화 로드맵 발표…리스크 관리 논의 병행 [세종=뉴시스] 강종민 기자 = 세종시 어진동 정부세종청사 재정경제부. 2026.01.06. ppkjm@newsis.

headlines.title: 재경부, '엔화→원화' 일본 현지 제3자 환전 시범거래 성공
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 일본 투자자 편의 제고…WGBI 투자여건 개선 연합뉴스 재정경제부는 27일 일본 현지에서 원화-엔화 '제3자 환전' 시범거래가 성공적으로 마무리됐다고 밝혔다. 제3자 환전은 투자자가 '해외 외국환업무 취급기관(RFI)' 등 임의의 환전은행과 외환자금을 환전하고 결제는 고객의 수탁은행을 통해 수행하는 방식을 말한다.

headlines.title: 日서 원화 3자 환전 시범거래 성공 …" 韓 국채 투자에 도움 "

headlines.title: 비행기 결항 돼도 면세품 반납 안 한다… 800달러까지 국내 반입 허용
headlines.summary: 재경부, 18개 세법 시행규칙 개정 희소병 치료제 관세 면제 범위 확대 웹툰 제작비 세액공제 대상 구체화 반도체 등 전략기술 투자 지원 강화 김병철 재정경제부 조세총괄정책관이 27일 정부세종청사에서 2025년 세제개편 후속 시행규칙 개정안을 설명하고 있다.

headlines.title: 차세대 반도체 소재·패키징도 전략기술 편입 … 투자세액공제받는다
headlines.summary: [세제개편 후속 시행규칙 개정] 사업화시설 61개→64개로 확대 친환경 첨단선박 관련혜택도 신설 입법예고 등 거쳐 다음달 중 시행 김병철 재정경제부 조세총괄정책관이 27일 정부세종청사에서 2025년 세재개편 후속 시행규책 개정안에 대해 설명하고 있다.

headlines.title: 1월 국세 52.9조…증시 활황·부동산 거래증가에 전년比 13 %↑
headlines.summary: 지난해 동월 대비 6.2조 원 증가 진도율, 5년 평균 대비 1%P 높아 증시 호조에 증권거래·농특세 확대 연합뉴스 부가가치세 환급 축소와 수입 증가, 고용 개선에 따른 근로소득세 확대에 더해 증시 거래대금 증가까지 겹치면서 연초 국세 수입이 지난해 대비 늘어난 것으로 나타났다.

headlines.title: " 이 가격 맞아 ?"… 민생물가 특별관리품목, 국민 목소리 듣는다
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 정부, '민생물가 특별관리품목' 국민 제안창구 개설 국민 제안창구 배너 이미지. 재정경제부 제공 정부가 체감 물가 안정과 민생부담을 줄이기 위해 국민 목소리를 직접 듣는 제도를 도입한다. 재정경제부는 27일 한국소비자단체협의회와 함께 '민생물가 특별관리품목 국민 제안창구'를 운영한다고 밝혔다.

headlines.title: 지난해 어업생산량 8.7%↑ … 생산금액 10조 2336억 '역대 최대'

headlines.title: 정부, 구글 에 고정밀 지도 국외 반출 조건부 허가
headlines.summary: 구글맵 정부가 구글이 요구하는 고정밀 지도의 국외 반출을 조건부로 허가하기로 했다. 국토교통부는 27일 경기도 수원시 영통구에 있는 국토지리정보원에서 ‘측량 성과 국외 반출 협의체’ 회의를 열고 1대 5000 고정밀 지도의 국외 반출 여부를 논의해 이 같이 결정했다.

headlines.title: “ 피지컬 AI · 수소 인프라 구축”… 현대차, 새만금 9조 투자

headlines.title: 현대차 , 새만금 에 ' 9조 ' 통 큰 투자 …'로봇·AI·수소' 핵심 거점 만든다

key_headlines.title: 2026 Mother Fund Increases Investment by 63%, Prioritizing 'Next Unicorn' Project
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's Ministry of SMEs and Startups has substantially boosted the Mother Fund's first regular investment for 2026 by over 60%. This increase aims to accelerate the 'Next Unicorn Project' by allocating funds upfront, which was previously reliant on a supplementary budget.

key_headlines.title: Deputy PM Goo Yun-cheol: Public Procurement to Catalyze AI Innovation, New AI-Dedicated Track Established
key_headlines.summary: Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Economy and Finance, Goo Yun-cheol, announced the creation of an 'AI-dedicated track' within public procurement to foster AI innovation. This initiative includes mandating domestic components for innovative AI products to strengthen the national supply chain.

key_headlines.title: Won Internationalization: Key Task for FX & Financial Market Leap, Pan-Government TF Launched
key_headlines.summary: A comprehensive government task force has been launched to advance the internationalization of the Korean Won, deemed crucial for the foreign exchange and financial markets. The task force will explore methods to enhance Won accessibility and expand cross-border transactions, with a roadmap anticipated in the first half of the year.

key_headlines.title: Ministry of Economy and Finance Successfully Pilots Third-Party JPY-KRW Exchange in Japan
key_headlines.summary: The Ministry of Economy and Finance successfully conducted a pilot third-party exchange of Japanese Yen to Korean Won in Japan, streamlining currency conversion for investors. This system allows investors to exchange funds through foreign exchange institutions, with settlement handled by their custodian bank, enhancing convenience for Japanese investors.

key_headlines.title: Successful Third-Party KRW Exchange in Japan Expected to Boost Korean Bond Investment
key_headlines.summary: The successful pilot of third-party Won exchange in Japan is set to diversify Won exchange routes for Japanese investors. This development is expected to significantly aid investment in Korean government bonds, especially in anticipation of their inclusion in the WGBI.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea is actively pushing for economic growth and market advancement through several strategic initiatives. The 2026 Mother Fund has seen a significant 63% increase in investment, prioritizing the 'Next Unicorn Project' to nurture innovative startups. Additionally, the government launched an 'AI-dedicated track' in public procurement to act as a catalyst for AI innovation, alongside a pan-governmental task force focused on internationalizing the Korean Won to strengthen foreign exchange and financial markets. A successful pilot of third-party JPY-KRW exchange in Japan is also expected to ease Korean bond investments for Japanese investors, collectively highlighting a robust drive for economic progress.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The Korean economy presents a mixed outlook, with the Bank of Korea raising its GDP growth forecast to 2.0% amid a vibrant stock market, yet domestic demand recovery remains sluggish despite strong exports. Commercial loan rates are climbing even as the central bank maintains its key interest rate for the sixth consecutive time, a trend attributed to increased government bond issuance and rising market rates. Discussions also explore how AI might influence interest rates and productivity, drawing parallels to past technological booms. Furthermore, the nation's foreign exchange reserves experienced a modest decline in February.
sections.Financial Markets: Escalating tensions in the Middle East are inducing significant anxiety across the domestic financial market, leading to heightened volatility in stock prices and exchange rates. Concerns are mounting over a potential 'financial shock' characterized by sharp declines in KOSPI and KOSDAQ, alongside the Won-Dollar exchange rate breaching critical psychological barriers, driven by fears of surging oil prices and a flight to safe-haven assets. Key US economic indicators, including employment and inflation data this week, are being closely watched for their potential impact on the Federal Reserve's future interest rate decisions and overall global market sentiment. Despite these looming threats, the KOSPI's robust performance has notably shifted investor preference towards domestic equity-focused ETFs.
sections.Industry & Technology: Korean battery manufacturers are strategically reorienting their focus beyond electric vehicles (EVs) towards emerging sectors such as Energy Storage Systems (ESS), AI data centers, robotics, and drones. Major companies are showcasing their advanced technologies in these areas at 'InterBattery 2026,' signaling a concerted effort to diversify portfolios amidst a decelerating EV market. Concurrently, Gyeongsangbuk-do province is developing a comprehensive robot strategy, aiming to establish an integrated ecosystem from component manufacturing to commercialization, incorporating AI, with expectations of significant investment and job creation. This pivot underscores a broader industrial strategy to expand battery applications and foster advanced manufacturing capabilities.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's officetel and villa monthly rent prices reached an unprecedented high in January, primarily due to uncertainties in apartment jeonse prices and a sustained preference for monthly rents in non-apartment housing. President Lee Jae-myung is pushing for real estate market normalization, potentially revising tax benefits for even single homeowners who do not reside in their properties, especially those with 'remote investments' in prime areas like Gangnam. While KB Real Estate reported an increase in Seoul apartment prices in February, the overall sentiment among real estate agents regarding future price appreciation has tempered.
sections.International Economy: Global financial markets are experiencing instability, with an unexpected rise in the US Producer Price Index (PPI) in January potentially influencing the Federal Reserve's interest rate cut timeline. This week, critical US economic data, including employment, unemployment, and retail sales figures, are anticipated to significantly shape the Fed's future monetary policy. Despite a generally hawkish stance, Chicago Fed President Goolsbee hinted at multiple rate cuts this year. Furthermore, the prospect of aggressive tariff policies under a potential Trump administration is a growing concern, prompting JP Morgan to lower its 2026 US GDP growth forecast, while geopolitical tensions and tariff uncertainties are bolstering safe-haven assets like gold.
sections.AI & Economy: The burgeoning investment in AI data centers is proving to be a powerful economic catalyst. Dell Technologies, a prominent server manufacturer, experienced a substantial nearly 22% surge in its stock price following impressive earnings, which were largely attributed to the heightened demand for AI-related infrastructure. This performance underscores how AI innovation, particularly in the expansion of data centers, is directly translating into considerable financial gains for companies within the technology sector. The robust growth observed in such companies highlights the profound economic impact and rapid development propelled by advancements in artificial intelligence.
sections.Others: The escalating Middle East situation, triggered by US airstrikes on Iran, has prompted an urgent response from the Korean government, with President Lee Jae-myung prioritizing the safety of Korean expatriates and convening an emergency National Security Council meeting to address security and economic impacts. Significant concerns exist due to Korea's 70% reliance on Middle Eastern oil and the potential disruption of the Strait of Hormuz, which could severely affect Korean industries through increased oil prices, higher shipping costs, and trade disruptions. Meanwhile, Bain Capital increased its stake in Ecomarketing to 91% through a second tender offer, and Korea Gas Corporation affirmed its sufficient supply readiness despite the regional instability.
